full_judgment:
Sheikh Abdul Awal J: This Rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the accused-petitioner should not be enlarged on bail in Panchlaish Police Station Case No. 14 dated 25-7-2016 corresponding to GR Case No. 180 of 2016 under sections 8/9/10/13 of the Santrash Birodhi Ain, 2009, now pending in the Court of Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Chittagong and/or such other or further order or orders passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 3. Upon the aforesaid First Information Report, Panchlaish Police Station Case No.14 dated 25-7-2016 under sections 8/9/10/13 of the Santrash Birodhi Ain, 2009 was started against the accused-petitioner and others. 

 5. Mr Abdus Salam, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that as per FIR version no incriminating leaflet or book was recovered /seized from the direct possession and control of the accused-petitioner, who has been falsely implicated in this case at the instance of the vested quarter. He further submits that the accused-petitioner has been languishing in jail hajot since 25-7-2016 on being arrested by the police without any trial and one of the accused namely, Fakhrul Abedin standing on same footing has already been released on bail by a Division Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. Case No. 42596 of 2016 and police has not yet been submitted any investigation report under section 173 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. Finally, the learned Advocate submits that the accused-petitioner is a student of Chittagong University having a brilliant academic career, unless he is allowed to go on bail his future career will be ruined. As such, the petitioner may kindly be enlarged on bail. 

 6. Mr Md Aminur Rahman Chowdhury, the learned Assistant Attorney-General appearing for the State, on the other hand, opposes the prayer for bail. He submits that the accused-petitioner is a active member of banned party, Hizbut Tahari and the investigation of the case is still going on. 

 8. A perusal of the FIR shows that no incriminating leaflet or book was recovered/ seized from the direct possession and control of the accused-petitioner. It further appears that the accused-petitioner is in custody since 25-7-2016 although, no investigation report under section 173 CrPC has been submitted, as yet, it is uncertain as to when the investigation of the case will be completed. Further, the materials on record are plainly insufficient to think that the petitioner was a active member of banned party named Hizbut Tahari. 

 9. Considering all these aspects of the case, particularly the fact that no leaflet or book of the banned party, Hizbut Tahari was recovered from the direct possession and control of the accused-petitioner, who is in custody for a long time and one of the FIR named accused standing on the equal footing has already been released on ad-interim bail by a Division Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. Case No. 42596 of 2016, there is no immediate prospect of holding trial, we are inclined to release the accused petitioner on bail.
